HediffDef.label: human-form role: engineer
HediffDef.description: This human-form synthetic is configured as an engineer. Its role controller periodically repairs damaged same-faction infrastructure and injured synthetic allies; an active commander mesh accelerates the response.

HediffDef.label: human-form role: infiltrator
HediffDef.description: This human-form synthetic is configured for precision sabotage. When openly hostile it prefers high-value power, research, communications, fabrication, shield, gravitic and control infrastructure when nearby defenders are not forcing direct combat. Disguise remains a separate infiltration system.

HediffDef.label: human-form role: soldier
HediffDef.description: This human-form synthetic is configured as a combat specialist. Hostile soldiers periodically reprioritise nearby player defenders rather than wasting specialist combat logic on low-value structures.

HediffDef.label: human-form role: coordinator
HediffDef.description: This human-form synthetic is configured as a local lattice coordinator and projects a bounded same-faction response mesh while its nanites are not EMP-disrupted.

HediffDef.label: human-form role: commander
HediffDef.description: This human-form synthetic is configured as a command node. It projects the strongest local response mesh and periodically requests fresh Pattern Archive backups for nearby linked same-faction synthetic minds.

HediffDef.label: human-form coordination mesh
HediffDef.description: This synthetic pawn is inside an active same-faction coordinator or commander mesh. Specialist response cadence improves while the link remains active; EMP disruption removes the mesh until coordination can be restored.
